title: Synthesis 6: heredity by intrinsic deaths is established in one class, but it selects a within-life decline; the heredity line now needs B
summary: One page at 11:25Z (P 62, K 8, C 40). Established since synthesis 5: the active-nematic SIMD colony (motility marginal on a fresh seed) and pcell's SIDH, the first H driven only by intrinsic deaths. The audits (c09, c06) show its death bias is mostly built within each cell's life by erosion of a public good, even with no explicit cost. A pure-efficiency trait removes the erosion and gives a response against an inert marker but runs away into giants; capped, it keeps 11-15 cells and makes dying cells low at birth (submitted). FCH lines freeze at carrying capacity. Next: B for C:autonomous-heredity, discrete kinds set at division, and life-course readouts in every H review.
